nom: Drunk Elephant T.L.C Sukari Babyfacial Exfoliating Mask

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily combination skin says it helps clear dullness and congestion without causing irritation.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers generally report smoother texture, fewer clogged pores and less congestion without over-drying their skin, though one combination/sensitive reviewer got two new pimples after a longer wear time.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: many say their skin tolerated it well once they started with a shorter wait time and built up gradually, while others report real tingling, burning or redness, and a few explicitly warn that very sensitive or barrier-damaged skin should avoid it or go very slowly.
segments.mature: One reviewer, aged 60, reports a visibly brighter, younger-looking complexion after just one use.

concerns.redness: Reviewers describe a tingling or stinging sensation during the mask that for some fades quickly with no lasting redness, while others, especially those with sensitive skin, report their face looks a little red right after rinsing and that skin becomes noticeably more sun-sensitive the next day.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers warn that anyone with a compromised or damaged skin barrier should avoid this mask or approach it very cautiously since the strong acid blend can irritate quickly; one reviewer specifically follows up with moisturizer and sunscreen to keep her barrier balanced afterward.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the mask doesn't leave skin feeling stripped, dry or greasy, and several note it eliminates flaking or dry patches; a few mention brief tightness right after rinsing that eases once the included facial oil or a moisturizer is applied.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers report the mask helps reduce blackheads, clogged pores and old acne marks over time, but one reviewer with combination/sensitive skin noticed two new pimples after leaving it on for the longer 20-minute wait time.
concerns.spots: A couple of reviewers report visible fading of dark spots and hyperpigmentation, including one whose cheek spots had lightened after weeks of consistent weekly use.
concerns.aging: A small number of reviewers mention a younger-looking, brighter complexion and reduced appearance of fine lines, including one 60-year-old reviewer who saw a visible difference after a single use.

aspects.libelle: Noticeable tingling or stinging on application
Rich, creamy texture, easy to spread
Comes with a bonus facial oil
A little goes a long way despite the price
Needs SPF afterward due to sun sensitivity

extraits.texte: I've been using BHA products weekly in my skincare routine for probably close to seven years, but they've never been the type to rinse off. So I was interested in this product, since it's almost like a mask! After using it a few times though, I think I prefer the leave-on/no-rinse type of BHA. (Gifted by Drunk Elephant)

Received this complimentary from Drunk Elephant. I am a big fan of Drunk Elephant products, so I was so excited to try this! I like that there is no cap to remove to dispense the product, it just comes out with a push of the top, but I do wish the applicator was able to be locked, especially since I like to bring my skincare products with me when I travel. The texture of the product itself is perfect - it wasn't too watery, it was just thick enough to spread and stay coated on my face. I started with a 10 minute wait, then on the following week I waited 20 minutes before rinsing the product off. My skin has noticeably looked brighter with a more even skintone. I have combo/sensitive skin and I did notice after using I had 2 new pimples show up, so I may stick to a shorter wait before rinsing.

extraits.titre: Extremely powerful, but for sensitive skin start slow
extraits.texte: I received the T.L.C. Babyfacial gifted by Drunk Elephant. This was actually my first experience with a Drunk Elephant product, after having heard so much buzz around it. It is meant to be a mini, at-home facial we do ourselves, recommended for once a week use on clean, dry skin. I used it at night, before applying my serums and moisturizers, after taking a shower. It has an earth, clay-type smell and a slightly thick texture. It takes a bit of product to spread to cover your entire face in an even layer. Almost immediately, there is a tingly, spicy, almost slightly burning feeling. Not unbearable, but it is definitely obvious. Granted, I also have sensitive skin in general. There is a note about this on the container though, so I knew to expect it, which made it more tolerable and not worrisome than if it had been a surprise. After leaving the mask on for a while, the feeling did go away, either on its own or from getting used to it. I left it on for 10 minutes as recommended for initial use in the directions, as opposed to the full 20 minutes for experienced users. I rinsed it off with warm water, dried my face and then used a few drops of the facial oil included in the pack. The next day, I had to rush out of the house and forgot to put on my daily sunscreen, and I could definitely feel my skin was more sensitive to the sun. It says in the instructions to make sure to use sunscreen daily since your skin will be more sensitive to sun exposure and they weren't lying or over

Complimentary from Drunk Elephant. I've been using it for a couple of weeks (once a week, because if you use it more, you're out of face) Drunk Elephant doesn't lie about "facial." As soon as you put it on, you feel a super intense tingling. It doesn't hurt, but it is that feeling of "this is working hard." If you have very sensitive skin or damaged barrier skin, don't even try, because it's a powerful AHA/BHA combo (25% and 2% respectively). It is easy to apply and comes with an oil (the Virgin Marula Oil) that is key. Don't ignore it. After rinsing the product, the skin is a little red and that oil is the only thing that soothes the feeling of tightness. What I notice most is the texture. I tend to have my pores in my nose and chin clogged, and this product literally sweeps everything. The next day, the skin feels very soft, as if I had had a professional peel in the clinic. The makeup is applied wonderfully afterwards.

As someone with combination skin, I totally get the hype around this product. Every time I use it, my skin looks smoother, brighter, and super glowy the next morning. It really helps with texture, clogged pores, and those little bumps around my T-zone without making my skin feel overly dry. That being said, it's STRONG. The tingling is real lol. I only use it once a week at night and always follow with a heavy moisturizer. Is it pricey? Yes. Will I keep buying it anyway? Also yes!! 10/10 glow and "fresh facial" skin at home. gifted by Drunk Elephant

Gifted by Drunk Elephant - I used this Babyfacial for 5 to 10 minutes weekly for a couple of weeks to test out the strength of the AHA & BHA on my sensitive skin. I noticed my skin was smoother and brighter after being consistent every week! It needs a small test run on sensitive skin, but overall I love how this adds a little TLC in a weekly skin reset! My dark spots have also lightened up around my cheeks, which is huge for me because they have been there for years!

I just turned 60 and wanted a mask that would help brighten my skin and get rid of that dull look. My red light therapy mask broke and I wasn't sure if it was worth replacing because I wasn't sure if it was doing any good. Chat GTP recommended this product instead and I couldn't be happier! Just after ONE use I could see a difference. I've added it to my weekly beauty routine and can really see an improvement in texture and brightness of my skin. It just looks younger and better!! So worth it!
